en-US.author: Jonathan Marler
en-US.description: A standalone tool for installing the MSVC toolchain and Windows SDK without Visual Studio.
en-US.longDescription:
msvcup is a standalone tool for installing the MSVC toolchain and Windows SDK without Visual Studio.
The Visual Studio Installer manages thousands of components, modifies the registry, and can take hours to configure. msvcup treats the toolchain as a versioned asset rather than global system state. The build environment is defined by code, not a GUI.
- Fast: Runs in milliseconds when already installed. Put it at the start of every build script.
- Reproducible: Lock file ensures everyone gets the same toolchain.
- Isolated: Every package is installed to its own versioned directory. No registry modifications. No conflicts.
- Cross-compilation: Target x64, arm64, or x86 out of the box.
- Minimal: Download only what's needed to get a working native toolchain/SDK.
en-US.name: msvcup
en-US.releaseNotes:
Highlights
Newer Windows SDKs now work. sdk-10.0.26100.15 installed without headers such as winapifamily.h, so anything including windows.h failed to compile. These headers moved to new packages that msvcup now installs. Packages for older SDKs don't change.
More reliable downloads. The Visual Studio CDN sometimes ends a download early, which used to fail the whole install. msvcup now tries up to 3 times and logs a warning for each failed attempt.
Bug fixes
- Fixed a panic when piping large output in Git Bash, such as msvcup list-payloads | grep foo.
- Fixed >> redirection overwriting the start of the file instead of appending.
- Fixed download errors and logs that left out the URL.
- Requesting a package that doesn't exist now fails straight away and names the package. It used to write a lock file first and then report a lock file mismatch.
Other changes
- list-payloads now shows which msvcup package owns each payload, and lists every payload in the manifest.
- Added -h/--help.
- Moved package selection from code into src/recipes.txt, one rule per line. This keeps the payload-to-package mapping as data and prepares for making it configurable.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/marler8997/msvcup/compare/v2026_04_08...v2026_11_02

zh-CN.description: 一个无需安装 Visual Studio 即可安装 MSVC 工具链和 Windows SDK 的独立工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
msvcup 是一个独立工具，用于安装 MSVC 工具链和 Windows SDK，而无需安装 Visual Studio。
Visual Studio 安装程序管理着数千个组件，会修改注册表，且配置可能耗时数小时。msvcup 将工具链视为带版本的资源，而非全局系统状态。构建环境由代码定义，而非图形界面。
- 快速：安装后运行仅需几毫秒。可将其置于每个构建脚本的开头。
- 可复现：锁定文件确保每个人获取相同的工具链。
- 隔离性：每个包都安装到其独立的版本化目录中。不修改注册表，无冲突。
- 跨平台编译：开箱即用地支持 x64、arm64 或 x86 目标架构。
- 轻量：仅下载构建可用的本地工具链/SDK 所需的最少内容。
